subject: Your VFTech account is closed
preheader: We've deleted your profile, sign-ins and requests.
footer_note: You're getting this one last email because your VF Tech account was closed.
body: Your VFTech account is now closed. We've deleted your profile, sign-ins and requests. Your invoices stay with our payment provider as tax records, and no further charges will be made.
You're welcome back any time: signing in with this email again starts a new account.
